title: Comfort Club Tier Schedule: Systems Enrolled, Equipment Age and Enrollment Inspection
content:
This schedule gives, for each tier of the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, how many heating and cooling systems one agreement may enroll, the oldest equipment the tier accepts, the age above which an enrollment inspection is needed, and the inspection fee.

| Tier | Most systems one agreement may enroll | Oldest equipment age accepted (years from install date) | Inspection needed for equipment older than (years) | Enrollment inspection fee per inspected system (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 2 | 25 | 12 | 79.00 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 3 | 25 | 12 | 79.00 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 4 | 20 | 12 | 59.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 4 | 20 | 12 | 0.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 4 | 15 | 10 | 0.00 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 6 | 15 | 10 | 0.00 |

## What each column means

- **Most systems**: the maximum number of heating or cooling systems a single agreement may enroll on that tier, as a whole number.
- **Oldest equipment age accepted**: the oldest equipment, counted in whole years from its install date, that may be enrolled under the tier.
- **Inspection threshold**: equipment older than this many years must pass an enrollment inspection before it is enrolled.
- **Inspection fee**: the fee per inspected system for the enrollment inspection; a fee of 0.00 means the inspection is performed without charge.

## Tier contrasts (read from the table)

- The age ceiling tightens as the tiers rise: 25 years on Comfort Club Basic and Comfort Club Silver, 20 years on Comfort Club Gold and Comfort Club Platinum, 15 years on Comfort Club Platinum Plus and Comfort Club Total Home.
- The inspection threshold is 12 years on the four lower tiers and 10 years on the two upper tiers.
- Comfort Club Platinum, Comfort Club Platinum Plus and Comfort Club Total Home inspect at no charge (0.00); Comfort Club Gold charges 59.00 and the two lowest tiers 79.00 per inspected system.
- Comfort Club Total Home is the only tier that enrolls up to 6 systems.
